title: Investing
learning_outcomes: Explain asset classes in the context of investing.
Compare and distinguish diversification and fees in the context of investing.
Apply compounding in the context of investing.
Evaluate and justify decisions about investment policy in the context of investing.

lessons.title: Asset classes
lessons.outcome: Explain asset classes in the context of investing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving asset classes; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional investment policy.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain asset classes from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of asset classes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Diversification and fees
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish diversification and fees in the context of investing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving diversification and fees; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional investment policy.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain diversification and fees from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of diversification and fees; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Compounding
lessons.outcome: Apply compounding in the context of investing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving compounding; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional investment policy.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain compounding from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of compounding; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Investment policy
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about investment policy in the context of investing.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving investment policy; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional investment policy.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain investment policy from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of investment policy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of asset classes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of diversification and fees; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of compounding; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of investment policy; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
